_comment: The security/perf GATE: runs on every push/PR. SAST + SCA + secrets + lint + perf-smoke + optional CodeQL. Installed by github_apply_gate / github_init_project, or included in stack recipes.
name: github-ci-security
description: Security/perf gate workflow: Bandit (SAST), pip-audit (SCA), gitleaks (secrets), Ruff lint, perf-smoke, CodeQL. Fails the build on findings — pair with branch protection to block merges.

variables.name: codeql_on
variables.description: true/false — include the CodeQL job (free on public repos)

variables.name: perf_test_path
variables.description: Path to the perf-smoke test file

variables.name: gitleaks_version
variables.description: Pinned gitleaks release (asset names are versioned — never use /latest/download)

notes: Installed automatically by github_apply_gate / github_init_project. Job names (sast, sca, secrets, lint, perf-smoke, codeql) are the branch-protection contexts. gitleaks downloads its own binary — no docker needed on runners.
